verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents its own automation: multi-step HR processes such as equipment requests or off-boarding with custom approval chains, automated hire-to-onboard flows, auto payroll for salaried employees, and AI that flags inconsistencies and texts admins. There is no evidence of a general user-defined rule builder in which arbitrary events trigger configurable actions. missing for 10: a documented event-trigger/condition/action rule engine, a list of supported trigger events and actions, user-authored custom rules beyond approval chains, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
